reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands as fully occupied ordered Ce3Mg3 in R-3m (No. 166), with 6 atoms in the conventional hexagonal cell (a=b=3.10510 A, c=17.79295 A, gamma=120 deg, V=148.570 A^3, Z=3) and primitive-standardizes to a 2-atom CeMg cell. All 22 observed maxima are covered by the calculated reflection set, including the resolved/merged high-angle overlaps, with no important off-model reflection. Atomic-coordinate evidence is strong: direct integration of the profile gives a 0.9998 observed-versus-calculated intensity correlation for the instantiated CIF, and a scan/refinement of the independent Ce-Mg layer displacement converges at z=0.500000; z=0.487 already fits materially worse and more displaced alternatives deteriorate sharply. The line-position RMS is about 0.0008 deg. Periodic neighbor shells show no overlaps (shortest distance 3.1051 A; shortest Ce-Mg 3.4653 A), full occupancies and correct stoichiometry, with a plausible metallic coordination topology. Swapping the two species is origin-equivalent here, while the tested symmetry-lowering displacement is rejected; no concrete incompatible realization survives the diffraction and validity checks.
